instruction: `moving_average(readings, window)` in telemetry.py drops the last full window; for example, [1, 2, 3, 4] with window 2 should give [1.5, 2.5, 3.5] but currently gives only two values. Fix it so it returns the mean of every run of `window` consecutive readings, in order, as floats. If `window` is larger than the number of readings, return an empty list.
